text:
maria: Brainstorm: consolidate Models / Deployments / Runtimes under a single left-rail parent called 'Inference' to reduce clutter. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/inference-rail-v3.png. Main asks: deep-link fidelity, breadcrumb display, and backward-compatible permalinks. Thoughts? :thought_balloon:

olivia: a11y first: when a deep link lands we must expand the parent and set aria-expanded=true, then move focus to the main H1. Also ensure breadcrumb is nav > ol > li with aria-current on active item.

kevin: Routing constraints: prefer canonical routes like /inference/models/:id. Keep server-side redirects from /models/:id -> /inference/models/:id and preserve query params. Avoid hash-only solutions.

sam: Router plan sketch:
```js
// redirect table
"/models/:id" -> "/inference/models/:id"
"/deployments/:id" -> "/inference/deployments/:id"

// deep-link flow
onRouteResolve(route){
  resolveRedirects();
  expandNavParentsSync();
  mountPage();
  focusMainHeading();
}
```
This avoids breadcrumb flashes and keeps history clean (use replaceState for in-UI toggles).

dan: Bookmarks question: we'll run redirects for at least 90 days and log telemetry when a redirect fires. Also show a tiny transient banner: "Redirected from /models/123 -> /inference/models/123" with dismiss so users can report stale links.

avin: Mobile nuance: if user has a persistent collapsed rail preference, deep-link should override only for that session so they land in content without changing saved preference. Also preserve query params (A/B) across redirects.

olivia: QA checklist request: 1) deep link into nested page with collapsed rail; 2) focus lands in main content; 3) breadcrumb semantic structure + SR full readout when truncated; 4) keyboard nav in icon-only mode; 5) preserved query params after redirect; 6) reduced-motion respected.

preview-bot: Prototype deployed: https://deploy.redwood/pr/1728 (inference-rail-v3). Includes keyboard walkthrough and a11y audit.

kevin: Saw preview  minor bug: prototype used a fragment to expand sections so breadcrumb didn't re-render. Sam please ensure expansion is route-driven and resolved before breadcrumb mounts.

sam: Will implement pre-resolve redirect + synchronous parent expansion. Also will add a short loading skeleton to avoid layout jank.

maria: Copy poll: 'Inference' vs 'Serve' vs 'Runtime'? My bias -> Inference (accurate). Anyone against?

dan: +1 Inference. Clearer across docs and avoids ambiguity.

olivia: +1. Add a tooltip: "Models, deployments, and runtimes for serving models." Also ensure localized strings are sent to i18n early.

maria: Great. Action items: Sam implements router pre-resolve + focus handling, Dan drafts redirect TTL + telemetry plan, Olivia publishes QA checklist to test infra, I'll update mocks and run a quick hallway test tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
